Smoke test: load latex and parse a simple snippet

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.tslp.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"language\":\"latex\"}", ProcessConfig::class.java)
    val result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("\\documentclass{article}\n\\begin{document}\nHello\n\\end{document}", config)
    println(result)
}
```
